{{Quotation|game|Those who stand at the Gates of Madness stand at the end of their own grasp on reality, because within, the vision of the [[Abaddon|dark god]] rules, and the twisted visions that his eyes have beheld will become the visions of all who pass through the gate. Nothing else remains except infinite, screaming madness.}}
{{Quotation|[[gw.dat]]|The Gate of Madness lies beyond the Domain of Secrets. It is the entrance to the Realm of Madness, which extends deep into the Realm of Torment. This deep well of madness acts as a buffer between Abaddon's ultimate prison and the great locks that have held him imprisoned in the Realm of Torment for a millennia.}}
The [[Gate of Madness (outpost)|Gate of Madness]] is the second to last of eight gates guarding the dark god Abaddon's prison realm. Beyond this blood stained gate is a realm of insanity and twisted visions.

==Getting there==
The [[primary quest]] [[All Alone in the Darkness]] will lead characters to this outpost, which is located close to the southwestern corner of the [[Domain of Secrets]].
